stem_book: A solid cylinder of mass m is kept on the edge of a plank of mass 2m and length 12 m, which in turn is kept on smooth ground. Coefficient of friction between the plank and the cylinder is 0.1. The cylinder is given an impulse which imparts it a velocity 7 m/s (along the plank) but no angular velocity. The time after which the cylinder falls off the plank is (g = 10 m/s²): (a) 2 s (b) 2.25 s (c) 2.5 s (d) 2.75 s
reason: Solid cylinder and g = 10 assumed into stem.
work: v_c = 7 − t, ωR = 2t, v_p = 0.5t; rolling when 7 − 3t = 0.5t ⇒ t = 2 s, rel. disp. = 12 − 1 = 11 m; then rel. speed 5 − 1 = 4 m/s for last 1 m ⇒ 0.25 s; total 2.25 s
